description: Add a durable strict factor validation operation for bundled alpha101/qlib158 factors over the native CSI300 panel. Require an explicit OOS split and Tushare environment token, preserve native rows/skips/source metadata, and refuse degraded baskets.

replacements.after:
def _run_strict_factor_validation(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> tuple[str, dict[str, Any]]:
    """Run the shipped cross-sectional strict benchmark through native code only."""
    inputs = {
        "zoo": payload["zoo"],
        "universe": "csi300",
        "start_date": payload["start_date"],
        "end_date": payload["end_date"],
        "oos_cutoff": payload["oos_cutoff"],
        "period": payload["period"],
        "random_control": True,
        "n_random_seeds": payload["n_random_seeds"],
        "horizon": payload["horizon"],
        "top": payload["top"],
    }
    references = {
        "zoo": inputs["zoo"],
        "universe": inputs["universe"],
        "period": inputs["period"],
        "oos_cutoff": inputs["oos_cutoff"],
    }

    # The hosted Mona runtime has no legacy dotenv/global Vibe credential
    # source. Only an explicitly injected process environment token may enable
    # the native Tushare loader; never ask the legacy settings accessor to find
    # one on disk.
    token = os.environ.get("TUSHARE_TOKEN", "").strip()
    if not token or token == "your-tushare-token":
        result = {
            "status": "error",
            "experiment_status": "unavailable",
            "reason_code": "tushare_token_unconfigured",
            "no_network_attempt": True,
            "inputs": inputs,
            "native_result": None,
        }
        return json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False), references

    try:
        from src.factors.bench_runner_strict import run_bench_strict

        native_result = run_bench_strict(
            zoo=inputs["zoo"],
            universe="csi300",
            period=inputs["period"],
            random_control=True,
            n_random_seeds=inputs["n_random_seeds"],
            oos_split=inputs["oos_cutoff"],
            horizon=inputs["horizon"],
            top=inputs["top"],
        )
    except Exception:  # persist a category only; never include provider secrets
        result = {
            "status": "error",
            "experiment_status": "failed",
            "reason_code": "strict_factor_execution_failed",
            "no_network_attempt": False,
            "inputs": inputs,
            "native_result": None,
        }
        return json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False), references

    metadata = native_result.get("meta") if isinstance(native_result, dict) else None
    error = native_result.get("error") if isinstance(native_result, dict) else None
    experiment_status = "failed"
    reason_code: str | None = "strict_factor_execution_failed"
    if isinstance(metadata, dict) and metadata and (
        metadata.get("degraded") is True
        or metadata.get("universe") != "csi300"
        or metadata.get("constituent_source") != "tushare index_weight"
    ):
        experiment_status = "unavailable"
        reason_code = "csi300_constituents_degraded"
    elif not isinstance(native_result, dict) or native_result.get("status") != "ok":
        error_text = error if isinstance(error, str) else ""
        if error_text.startswith("universe load failed:") or error_text.startswith("forward returns failed:"):
            experiment_status = "unavailable"
            reason_code = "csi300_data_unavailable"
        elif error_text.startswith("OOS boundary ") or "no valid alpha rows" in error_text:
            experiment_status = "unavailable"
            reason_code = "strict_factor_oos_unavailable"
        elif "no alphas registered" in error_text:
            experiment_status = "failed"
            reason_code = "strict_factor_execution_failed"
        else:
            experiment_status = "failed"
            reason_code = "strict_factor_execution_failed"
    elif (
        not isinstance(metadata, dict)
        or not metadata
        or metadata.get("universe") != "csi300"
        or metadata.get("constituent_source") != "tushare index_weight"
    ):
        experiment_status = "unavailable"
        reason_code = "csi300_constituents_degraded"
    elif not native_result.get("rows") or native_result.get("n_alphas_tested", 0) < 1:
        experiment_status = "unavailable"
        reason_code = "strict_factor_no_testable_rows"
    else:
        experiment_status = "completed"
        reason_code = None

    result = {
        "status": "ok" if experiment_status == "completed" else "error",
        "experiment_status": experiment_status,
        "reason_code": reason_code,
        "no_network_attempt": False,
        "inputs": inputs,
        # Keep the native payload intact, including degraded metadata, skips,
        # and partial rows; the outer status prevents degraded data being read
        # as a valid CSI300 result.
        "native_result": native_result,
    }
    return json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False), references
